parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity/expression, no documented border/document friction for visitors, no state-directed targeting, plus progressive rulings, pride events and curriculum content. Offsetting: documented societal hostility reaching visibly trans people — discrimination in public spaces and government institutions and frequent physical/sexual harassment in provincial cities (Nov 2024), thin recourse, conversion therapy practised, and rising political hate speech (2024 anti-LGBT rally; April 2026 leader's derogatory video with death threats from supporters). Worst feature is tier-3 societal hostility with thin recourse, not tier-1 state exposure. No trans-specific killing rate with denominator exists, so no campaign can be inferred. Resident-facing LGR/marriage gaps are climate signals only. Net: elevated-to-reduced risk, worse outside the capital.
